comments.body: Closed after portal copy and numbers matched line items in production checks.

content.text: Closed after portal copy and numbers matched line items in production checks.
The portal Billing Questions page explains proration with amounts that do not match the invoice line items for the same period.
Customers open tickets citing the mismatch even when the invoice itself is correct, driving avoidable support volume.
Recalculate the explanation widget from the same proration service used for invoice generation and add a snapshot test for mid-cycle upgrades.
